home.heroDescription: One account and injector for two distinct clients: Minecraft 26.2 and Forge 1.8.9. Choose the matching game version before injection; each version receives its own signed DLL release.

features.title: Version-Matched Runtime
features.desc: Separate DLL releases for the modern client and Forge 1.8.9. The injector requests only the release selected for the target game, while existing 26.2 releases remain on their original channel.

features.title: Client-Specific Rendering
features.desc: Each client retains its own rendering stack and ClickGUI, designed for its Minecraft version. Shared account delivery does not force the two game runtimes into one implementation.

features.title: Cloud Cryptography & Safety
features.desc: Encrypted DPAPI hardware fingerprinting, dynamic timestamp request windows, and one-time download tickets ensuring secure and exclusive client distribution.

features.title: Frosted Glass ClickGUI
features.desc: Apple-inspired fluid ergonomics with cubic-bezier transition curves, real-time palette customizer, and an interactive module drawer designed for rapid in-game tuning.
